summary.result: It was also found that there is a significant difference between ordinary vending machines and machines certified for being eco-friendly and energy efficient, in terms of electric power consumption.
summary.background: We chose 10 universities located in the city of Seoul and Gyeonggi province and measured electricity consumption of 10 vending machines installed in each university.
summary.method: According to the result of the calculation, it is estimated that the machines studied on consume 700 KWh a year.
